jobs.description:
Job description
**Job Title Senior SAP Basis / Platform Operations Lead**


**Location \-** Remote (USA)


**What you'll be doing**


As a Senior SAP Basis / Platform Operations Leadyou will be a part of an Agile team to build healthcare applications and implement new features while adhering to the best coding development standards.


**Responsibilities: \-**


Role Overview :


We are seeking a hands\-on Senior SAP Basis / Platform Operations Lead to oversee SAP platform operations, production support, and infrastructure administration.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP landscapes and be capable of independently managing complex production issues while driving operational excellence.


**Key Responsibilities :**


Provide leadership and support for SAP Basis and platform operations.


Independently troubleshoot and resolve production issues across SAP environments. Coordinate effectively with SAP teams, AMS teams, and stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution. Enhance platform monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) processes. Support platform administration activities and provide backup coverage for assigned operational controls. Extensive hands\-on experience in SAP Basis Administration. Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA environments. Experience with SAP RISE implementations and operations. Excellent stakeholder management and coordination abilities.


Preferred Skills Experience with SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management). Hands\-on expertise with Convergent Charging and Convergent Mediation. Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise SAP environments.

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Functional
jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP BRIM Functional Data Analyst based in India.**
 Join a team supporting enterprise\-scale SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) initiatives, with a focus on data analysis, quality, migration, and reporting. In this senior functional role, you will work across subscription management, charging, invoicing, and financial processes. You will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of critical billing and customer data throughout migration and integration activities. Working closely with business stakeholders, SAP specialists, architects, and technical teams, you will translate business needs into reliable functional data solutions. Your contributions will support effective reporting, sound financial reconciliation, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within complex enterprise SAP environments while supporting business\-critical operations.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute to SAP BRIM data analysis, migration, reporting, and governance activities, ensuring that enterprise billing and financial information remains accurate and reliable.
   

  

* Analyze and support SAP BRIM data structures and business processes across Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA).
* Support data\-related activities covering customer accounts, subscriptions, billing, invoicing, payments, and receivables management.
* Identify, investigate, and help resolve data quality issues across SAP BRIM environments.
* Develop and maintain source\-to\-target mapping documents, data transformation rules, validation procedures, and reconciliation documentation.
* Analyze legacy system data and support its mapping to SAP BRIM target structures.
* Contribute to data migration activities, including extraction, cleansing, transformation, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with migration architects and technical teams to resolve migration defects and support mock conversions, cutover planning, and production deployments.
* Support the development and validation of billing reports, revenue and invoicing analytics, customer account reports, financial reconciliation reports, operational dashboards, and KPIs.
* Respond to business reporting and data analysis requests while ensuring outputs align with operational and regulatory requirements.
* Engage with stakeholders to gather and document data and reporting requirements, analyze business processes, and identify opportunities for improved data quality and process optimization.
* Translate business requirements into functional data specifications and support workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions.
* Work with SAP BRIM consultants, SAP S/4HANA teams, data architects, integration specialists, and developers to support data integration and reconciliation across connected systems.
* Develop and execute data validation scripts, test scenarios, user acceptance testing (UAT), and reconciliation tests.
* Track defects, investigate issues, validate end\-to\-end data flows, and verify reporting outputs.
* Maintain functional specifications, data dictionaries, governance documentation, reporting definitions, and operational procedures.
* Support enterprise data governance, compliance, audit requirements, and established data quality standards.
* Provide user support, troubleshooting assistance, and knowledge transfer to improve adoption of SAP BRIM data and reporting processes.


**Requirements**
 The ideal candidate combines strong SAP data analysis experience with practical knowledge of enterprise billing processes, data migration, reporting, and financial reconciliation.
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in SAP data analysis, reporting, or functional support roles.
* At least 4 years of direct experience supporting SAP BRIM or related SAP billing environments.
* Proven experience with enterprise billing, invoicing, subscription management, and customer account processes.
* Strong understanding of SAP BRIM data structures and business processes, including billing and invoicing operations.
* Experience supporting data migration, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Solid knowledge of enterprise data management, data quality principles, reporting, analytics, and financial reconciliation.
* Practical experience with SQL, data analysis tools, SAP reporting tools, and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications, testing documentation, and data governance materials.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and requirements discussions.
* Strong organizational and documentation abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, or SAP Data Services (BODS).
* Familiarity with enterprise ETL platforms and reporting tools.
* Experience in utilities, telecommunications, transportation, finance, or subscription\-based industries.
* Exposure to Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Previous consulting or contractor experience in enterprise SAP environments.


**Preferred Certifications**
* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management.
* SAP Certified Application Associate – Financial Contract Accounting (FI\-CA).
* SAP S/4HANA certifications.
* Data analytics or business intelligence certifications.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Busines

**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
 You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation\-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.

 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:

* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.

Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. jobs.description:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP\-enabled solutions.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/15/2027\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Manager on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live activities.
  

* Lead SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) design and delivery on SAP S/4HANA programs, from fit\-gap assessment through build, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
* Own solution design for ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including performance obligation determination, standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and contract combinations.
* Assess and design solutions for complex revenue scenarios, including cross\-company contracts, percentage\-of\-completion, multi\-element arrangements, and in\-flight contract migration; support OCM capabilities and migration from CCM to OCM; and support integration between SD\-RAR and SOM\-RAR.
* Lead functional design and oversee configuration, data migration, testing, defect management, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and change adoption.
* Design RAR integrations with BRIM, Sales and Distribution (SD) and billing, Project Systems, configure\-price\-quote (CPQ) platforms, Universal Journal, and reporting and analytics; apply SAP BRF\+ and other SAP capabilities to support rules\-based determination and address solution gaps through Clean Core\-aligned options, including Business Technology Platform (BTP) extensions, hybrid approaches, and controlled custom development.
* Advise client stakeholders on RAR design decisions and their business or compliance implications; contribute to proposals, client presentations, and key design\-decision documentation; and mentor and review team members' work while supporting quality, knowledge transfer, stakeholder communications, and training.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP\-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first\-time implementations, business\-led enhancements, and large\-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.  

  

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required**  

* Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree plus 10\+ years of experience in SAP, ERP, or consulting
* 8\+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end\-to\-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both
* 4\+ years of SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) experience, including solution design and hands\-on configuration supporting ASC 606 or IFRS 15 requirements
* Experience delivering at least 2 full\-lifecycle SAP RAR implementations or migrations, with a primary delivery or workstream leadership role on at least 1; at least 1 must be on SAP S/4HANA
* Experience designing a solution for at least 1 of the following revenue scenarios: cross\-company contract combinations, percentage\-of\-completion, or multi\-element SSP allocation
* Experience presenting SAP RAR design decisions to client stakeholders
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

**Preferred**  

* 2\+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting transformation engagements
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Finance, RAR, or Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM), or a CPA or CA credential.
* Experience with BRF\+ for rules\-based determination (POB, SSP) and moving custom ECC logic to Clean Core\-compliant designs.
* Experience with in\-flight contract migration, opening\-balance reconciliation, and SOX / audit trail design.
* Experience with pre\-sales and orals, including proposal contributions.
* Experience evaluating or applying SAP Business AI or Joule use cases involving contract and performance obligation interpretation, AI\-assisted standalone selling price estimation, ABAP remediation, or continuous controls monitoring , including documentation of human\-review considerations.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced SAP Convergent Charging (CC) Functional Consultant with hands\-on experience in implementing, configuring, and developing objects in SAP Convergent Charging. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of SAP CC functionalities, charging processes, and integration with SAP BRIM solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Implement and configure SAP Convergent Charging solutions based on business requirements.
* Develop and maintain SAP CC objects, including charge plans, charging plans, pricing plans, and mapping tables.
* Configure charging, pricing, and rating processes.
* Work on recurring, one\-time, and usage\-based charging scenarios.
* Support integration of SAP CC with SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and SAP SOM.
* Perform functional testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with technical and functional teams for implementation and deployment.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in SAP Convergent Charging (SAP CC).
* Experience in implementing and developing objects in SAP CC.
* Strong knowledge of charging and rating processes.
* Experience with charge plans, pricing plans, and mapping tables.
* Understanding of SAP BRIM processes and integration.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and SAP SOM.
* Knowledge of subscription\-based and usage\-based billing.
* Experience in SAP BRIM implementation projects.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As Senior SAP Basis / Platform Operations Lead on \<US*DRIVER*LICENSE\>, you’ll guide reliable, secure platform operations across enterprise systems. You’ll lead system administration, software implementation and administration, configuration management, and technical troubleshooting support. You’ll partner with IT, systems engineering, and application teams to strengthen system architecture and keep services available. Your impact: By improving platform reliability and recovery readiness, you help application teams deliver dependable services to the people who rely on them.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead server administration and system administration, including Windows Server, Linux, UNIX, VMware ESXi, virtualization, storage management, RAID controllers, and server backup and recovery.
* Drive automation, scripting, system tuning, performance tuning, load balancing, and software troubleshooting across IT infrastructure.
* Support information security and computer networking, including Active Directory management, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, and operating systems.
* Guide solution architecture, system design, service\-oriented architecture, microservices, and systems and applications support.
* Coordinate DevOps and Agile delivery through the software development life cycle (SDLC), Git, Jenkins, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).

**Experience**

* Demonstrated experience leading platform operations, systems engineering, computer management, and technical troubleshooting; a computer science background is useful.
* Familiarity with AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, Pegasystems, REST (Representational State Transfer), RESTful APIs (application programming interfaces), and APIs.
* Working knowledge of SQL (Structured Query Language), T\-SQL (Transact\-SQL), PL/SQL (Procedural Language/SQL), Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and NoSQL databases.
* Scripting experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, Bash (Unix shell), or other shell scripting tools; understanding of software administration and implementation practices.

Pay: $65\.00 \- $72\.00 per hour

Experience:

* SAP S/4HANA: 5 years (Required)
* RISE: 5 years (Required)
* BRIM: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Operational procedures.
* Support enterprise data governance and compliance initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to data quality standards and audit requirements. Training \& User Support.

* Assist business users with troubleshooting and operational reporting needs.

jobs.description:
Santa Clara, California, United States of America Accounting Ref ID: JR\-023709  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


Job Summary
  

Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager, Revenue and Quote to Cash (QTC) Transformation to join our finance, accounting, and operations organization.


Our finance, accounting, and operations groups support business infrastructure, automation, building solutions, and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our stakeholders. Your efforts will directly impact the ongoing transformation and success of a world\-leading cybersecurity business.


You’ll lead key optimization work streams within complex business, financial, and technology problems. You possess a unique blend of business knowledge, a deep understanding of the end\-to\-end QTC process and related systems, importance of data integrity, completeness and accuracy, coupled with a focused transformation mindset.

  

  

This is a visible role with significant cross\-functional interaction within and beyond finance organization. As a key driver of execution, it’s critical that you possess strong leadership and communication skills, and the confidence and adaptability to manage stakeholders to advance practical, strategic, and quality decision\-making, and achieve our desired business outcomes.  



  

The role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue and QTC Transformation, and partner closely with IT Managers, Program Operations, and other process leaders within the finance, accounting, sales, and product organizations.  



  

Key Responsibilities


* Support and drive the evaluation of current QTC processes and systems to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement within assigned scope areas.
* Drive and execute identified initiatives within the Revenue Operations team, as well as cross\-functional initiatives requiring Revenue Operations involvement. This includes designing and implementing streamlined, scalable processes and systems. The goal is to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the company's agility in adapting to evolving go\-to\-market strategies and business growth.
* Partner with IT, front office operations, go\-to\-market \& sales team and program operations to manage the execution of specific transformation initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and effective change management.
* a strong understanding of best\-in\-class QTC process and underlying systems’ capabilities to drive standardization and harmonization across defined areas of the quote\-to\-cash domain.
* Develop rapport, credibility, and strong relationships across the organization.
* Clearly articulate ideas and proposals to build support for key project decisions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate them into actionable project plans.
* Communicate project / initiative status, risks, and recommendations to leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with project / initiative goals.
* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing team or cross\-functional project members, encouraging continuous learning and professional growth.
* Drive teams to address critical operational and strategic questions facing the organization through structured problem\-solving, research, and analysis.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications


* 10 \+ years of relevant experience within the tech industry, with a combination of experience at an accounting / consulting practice and industry experience at a top\-tier tech company.
* Accounting, Finance, Business and/or Operations Process Management degree (or equivalent experience or equivalent military experience) required. MBA and CPA or equivalent preferred.
* Experience with M\&A and process integration methodology, practical execution, business process and operational adoption, large scale data migration and conversion execution.
* Experience in practical execution of large scale QTC transformation projects.
* Strong understanding of revenue operations and accounting (including sound knowledge of US GAAP, ASC 606 and relevant internal controls) for an enterprise business across various business models including hardware, software, subscription, consumption / usage, and multiple go to market motions such as direct, distributions / resellers, marketplace, partnerships, etc.
* Understanding of QTC process and systems that support and enable it including Master Data Management, Contract Lifecycle Management, Deals Desk, Configure\-Price\-Quote, Order Management, Invoicing, Cash Application, Credit \& Collections, Returns, Revenue Recognition \& Reporting.
